notes: needs_ruling (rule 11, narrated encounter): the testator Musa ibn Ja'far is named in the words «أن أبا إبراهيم موسى بن جعفر أشهد على وصيته» and speaks the will; whether he is a last link or only in the scene is for the ruling
«عدة من أهل بيته» is a collective unnamed link (rule 8); «رضي الله عنه» and «عليهما السلام» are blessings and are left out
